title: The Last Starfighter #4
desc: NEW SHIPS, OLD TRICKS! The Ko-Dan Armada sets a trap for the Star League and its fledgling recruits! Alex Rogan is the only one among the Starfighters with real battle experience—and that terrifies him. But he’s still the best pilot in the galaxy, and with the newly upgraded Gunstars, they might just keep the Armada at bay. But the Blackstar Squadron doesn’t need new technology to outwit a young Star League Commander… The direct sequel to the beloved sci-fi film continues!
